arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos Pre-Auth Failure Followed by Success
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4771
detection:
  initial:
    EventID: 4771
    LogonType: 3
  successful_login:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 3
    SourceNetworkAddress: '%SourceNetworkAddress%'
    User: '%User%'
  timeframe: 5m
condition: initial and successful_login
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1212/
description: Detects a failed Kerberos pre-authentication followed by a successful network logon from the same source IP and user within 5 minutes, indicative of AS-REP roasting or password guessing.
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate user typos followed by correction
  - Automated service account rotations

title: Suspicious Kerberos Pre-Auth Failure Followed by Success

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns typical of Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20240315"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-by-NC-SA 4.0"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 } // Common stack allocation pattern
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 7.0; Windows NT" wide ascii
        $c = "X-MicrosoftAjax: Delta=true" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
